title: sorghum vulgare var. nigricans
intro: Sorghum vulgare var. nigricans, commonly known as Black Sorghum, is a variety of the Sorghum vulgare plant, which is a type of grain native to Africa and Asia. Black Sorghum is valued for its numerous health benefits, including its ability to help manage blood sugar levels, lower cholesterol, and improve cardiovascular health. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its potential use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Black Sorghum include phenolic compounds, flavonoids, and anthocyanins, which are responsible for its medicinal and antioxidant properties.
